method: Learned graph-network simulator (GNS, Sanchez-Gonzalez et al. 2020; Kumar & Vantassel 2023) trained on a self-generated 2D numba-DEM granular column-collapse dataset; rollout vs DEM on held-out columns
code: geoelements/gns LearnedSimulator (own training loop with the gns loss/noise) + self-written numba DEM

key_results.route: self-generated dataset (no small pretrained 2D sand GNS model available; gns-sample has only WaterDropSample data, no checkpoint)

notes: Reduced GNS (5 message-passing steps, latent 64) trained ~5000 steps on 1 CPU thread, versus ~1e6+ steps in the papers. Rollouts track the DEM for the two in-range columns (runout within -6 % and +20 % of the DEM runout distance) and blow up for the taller, out-of-range column (test_1, H/W 2.6).
